input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: My first auditor brief went out with unfilled SUBJECT_PATH/STRATUM placeholders; that auditor stopped and asked rather than guessing, and a follow-up message fixed it (cost about one extra agent round).

My first garment duplicate-option test duplicated the best option, which the tie rule treats as right, so the test could not fail; quality_mutate.py showed the mutant survived and I fixed the test before committing.

CI 'validate' failed: my VENTURE.yaml description edit introduced ': ' inside an unquoted YAML scalar. portfolio/router/validate.py catches it locally in a second; I had not run it. Fixed in a follow-up commit.

doc_friction.issue: quality_mutate.py runs the test command from the subject's private copy, so test paths must be relative to the subject (tests, not research/<x>/tests); giving the repo-relative path fails with a confusing 'baseline failed: the suite is red' message. One line in the README would save a retry.

--for-changes on a PR that touches a venture and a post pulls in portfolio-pages 'Test the site builder', which ran past 100 s and was still silent minutes later; the venture and post checks it actually needed ran in seconds via run_venture_tests.py and check_post_*.py.

deviations.why: Step 4 says to fix what is small and safe; the Turo market fix is a feature-sized change (new input, copy on five files), not a one-line constant.
deviations.did: Fixed it in this PR anyway, since it was a high-severity wrong payout most US users would act on and the flat rates are exactly the existing 3-13 column, with a test pinning every published value and a Chromium check of both modes.
deviations.result: 56/56 venture tests pass; the two previously surviving mutants and a new market-check mutant are caught.

notes: Mode sample (quality_audit.py mode). Seed 2026-11-13-f, round 60. Subjects: ventures/turo-host-payout-calculator, ventures/restaurant-delivery-commission-analyzer, research/stop-twin, research/garment-wearwrong; no flagship/platform drawn (all recently audited). Share meeting the bar: 0 of 4 (sampled total 31 of 254, Wilson 9-17%). Seeded bugs caught 7 of 20. Fix PR: #15385 (turo market share, garment headline + tests, stop-twin tests + caveats). Spot-checks by lead session: fetched Turo's help page (nine-market variable share confirmed) and re-ran the auditor's check.mjs (3/12 flat cells right before fix); re-ran stop-twin exact-coverage script (0.95002/3.561, 0.95001/2.057 match paper); read garment results.txt rows (+0.184 C at $50, e=0.3). Lowered stop-twin claims 3->2 (reason in file). Verification: node --test 56/56 turo; run_venture_tests.py both ventures ok; stop-twin unittest 10/10; garment pytest 7/7; quality_mutate: 8 of the 13 surviving mutants now caught; check_post_frontmatter/links/similarity clean; quality_audit.py validate 0 problems. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: front-matter and pages steps ok, 'Test the site builder' left to CI. No separate agent doc in docs/reports: the audit files and post carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: four independent expert audits (~2 h each) plus a small feature fix and tests

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
